strategy_roster.name: Scalping 15m EMA MACD RSI ATR
strategy_roster.entry_long: close > ema(close,50) and macd(close,12,26) > macd_signal(close,12,26,9) and rsi(close,14) >= 50 and rsi(close,14) < 70
strategy_roster.notes: EMA(50), MACD 12/26/9, and RSI 50-70 retain the documented long setup. The inverse momentum/RSI condition is an exit proxy; 1x/2x ATR protections are dynamic price distances.

strategy_roster.name: MACD + Bollinger Bands + RSI
strategy_roster.entry_long: macd(close,12,26) > 0 and close < bb_lower(close,20,2) and rsi(close,14) < 30
strategy_roster.exit_long: macd(close,12,26) < 0 and close > bb_upper(close,20,2) and rsi(close,14) > 70
strategy_roster.notes: MACD 12/26, Bollinger(20,2), and RSI(14) thresholds are exact for the long pullback and mirror exit. The documented signal length is unused by the stated entry, and no stops are specified.

strategy_roster.name: Pivot Heiken
strategy_roster.notes: Regular bullish/bearish candles and SMA(20) are explicit fallbacks for Heikin-Ashi direction and the previous daily pivot. Pip stop, target, and trailing levels are not percentage fields.

strategy_roster.name: Economic Policy Uncertainty
strategy_roster.notes: A price-trend SMA cross is a single-security fallback because the external EPU index and its fixed threshold 187 are unavailable. The documented SMA length 2 is retained; the 10-bar holding timer is unsupported.

strategy_roster.name: Kolier SuperTrend
strategy_roster.notes: EMA(10) is an explicit proxy for the unavailable ATR-based SuperTrend and retains its period. The multiplier-three band state, four-hour context, and short side are omitted.

strategy_roster.name: BBStrategy
strategy_roster.entry_long: bars_since(close > bb_upper(close,20,2)) < 3 and close <= bb_upper(close,20,1) and close > bb_mid(close,20)
strategy_roster.notes: Period 20 with inner/outer deviations 1/2 are explicit fallbacks; a recent two-SD pierce followed by return inside the one-SD band retains the delayed-entry logic. Point protection is unsupported.

strategy_roster.name: Twenty200 Time Breakout
strategy_roster.notes: Four-bar open ROC approximates the far/near six-versus-two-bar comparison, and 0.1% is an explicit delta fallback. Trade-hour scheduling, pip thresholds, 504-hour exit, and auto sizing are unavailable.

strategy_roster.name: Altarius RSI Stochastic
strategy_roster.notes: RSI(3) versus EMA(9) is a fallback for the two stochastic pipelines, with oversold 30 and documented long-exit RSI 60. Stochastic differences, adaptive sizing, and drawdown exits are unsupported.

strategy_roster.name: List Positions
strategy_roster.notes: The source is explicitly a monitoring-only position logger, so an impossible negative-price guard avoids inventing trades. Portfolio snapshots, filters, and timers are unsupported.

strategy_roster.name: The MasterMind
strategy_roster.notes: RSI(100) is a fallback for stochastic %D and Williams %R, retaining the extreme long threshold 3. Point-based stop, target, trailing, and break-even settings are not percentage fields.
